verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the framed box is left empty, the headline sits outside it on bare white, the logo and orange triangle are dumped in the bottom-left corner, and the brush-stroke background is cut down to a thin strip on a white canvas, so the design is barely recognisable. B keeps the box, logo, triangle and headline together as one unit and the headline reads well, but the brushstroke background is cropped to a thin band, leaving large dead white areas above and below; the triangle and logo are stacked down the left side instead of in their original corner spots; and the headline crowds the right edge of the frame.
